title: CAPEX Sub-Lines Save/Load Wiring

files_changed.rationale: Add high-level save/load helpers: replace_sub_lines_for_project (soft-delete + re-insert in caller-controlled transaction), get_active_sub_lines_for_project (load wrapper), soft_delete_sub_line_for_project (alias).

Extend save_project with optional capex_sub_lines parameter (backward-compatible: defaults to None). Add get_project_with_sub_lines and get_project_by_id_with_sub_lines load helpers. The save flow runs the sub-line replace in the same get_cursor() transaction as the project row INSERT.

Extend update_scenario_overrides with reserved-key allowlist (_capex_sub_line_overrides, _capex_sub_line_overrides_metadata). The allowlist is consulted BEFORE the SCENARIO_INPUT_FIELDS silent-drop rule, so the additive change does not affect existing override behavior. SCENARIO_INPUT_FIELDS still has 21 flat-path keys.

35 design-contract tests pin the save/load + scenario-override contracts. Test classes: TestSaveProjectAcceptsSubLines, TestUUIDStabilityAcrossRoundTrip, TestLoadHelpers, TestCanonicalOrder, TestScenarioOverrideAllowlist, TestEffectiveSubLineAmountReplaceNotDelta, TestFactoryProjectGuard, TestSoftDeleteSafety, TestNoProductionCodeChanged, TestRc1Frozen, TestPhasePlanAndHardNoGo.

save_flow.transaction: single get_cursor() context wraps both project row INSERT/UPDATE and sub-line soft-delete+re-insert
save_flow.uuid_preservation: supplied sub_line_id reused on insert; empty sub_line_id auto-generates a fresh UUID; both paths preserve identity across round-trips
save_flow.soft_delete_safety: existing active rows soft-deleted (is_active=0) before new set inserted; soft-deleted rows kept for audit / replay; any soft-deleted row sharing a sub_line_id with the new set is permanently deleted to allow the UNIQUE constraint to pass
save_flow.factory_guard: assert_project_allows_capex_sub_lines raises PermissionError for factory_template projects; this is defense in depth on the save flow boundary
save_flow.backward_compat: capex_sub_lines parameter defaults to None; omitting it produces no sub-line side effects (existing callers unaffected)

load_flow.canonical_order: (parent_category_code ASC, display_order ASC); matches LineItemGrid render path
load_flow.soft_delete_filter: soft-deleted rows excluded by default; pass include_inactive_sub_lines=True for audit / replay

scenario_override_flow.phase_20b_invariant: unknown keys continue to be silently dropped (additive allowlist does not change this)
scenario_override_flow.effective_amount_semantic: override REPLACES default (NOT a delta); pinned by resolve_effective_sub_line_amount helper from 57A-9B
scenario_override_flow.base_case_rejection: base-case scenarios still reject override attempts (unchanged behavior); reserved keys are for non-base scenarios only

stop_after_report_contract.rationale: 57A-9C is the first runtime PR that touches the persistence layer for the 57A-9 sub-arc. The save/load wiring introduces new transaction patterns (soft-delete + re-insert in caller cursor) and a new scenario-override allowlist. User review of the locked contracts (UUID identity, override-replaces-default, factory guard) is required before the next runtime PR (57A-9D) begins.
